Game Overview

Ugi Bugi & Kisiy Misiy Summer is a two-player game built around guide Ugi and Kisiy through a playful summer adventure filled with vibrant pixel art and co-op fun. Dodge thorns and navigate levels beneath a giant tree. With each increasingly challenging level, teamwork and patience are key to reaching your safe spot and outmaneuvering the searing summer heat.
